question: How may the inner bathing forms be practiced?
premises: Eight forms are taught, each proceeding from the dvādaśānta.
One may perform any one of these baths.
One may also perform them in two, three, or more modes.
inference: The inner bath can be practiced flexibly using one or several of the eight forms arising from the dvādaśānta.
uncertainties: dvitryādiśaḥ may refer to directions, modes, or counts; translated as modes.
plain_english: Eight forms are taught, each arising from the dvādaśānta. One may perform any one of these baths, or do them in two, three, or more ways.
